Marketing_Bundle_dotAGE_Description: Celebrate the collaboration between two roguelite city builders! Encounter new events in dotAGE to find a Beaver VIP and help him get safe passage into your town. Start a new World Event in Against the Storm to convince the Elder the cataclysm isn't coming — and gain a purring ally.
Marketing_Description_Long_Villagers_Tex: Beavers, lizards, and foxes stand alongside humans and harpies in the struggle to survive. Utilize each group’s strengths as you balance their varying needs, from housing and culinary preferences to taste in luxuries and recreation. Manufacture raincoats, brew ale, and bake pies to boost morale in the face of the oppressive hostility of the forest.
Marketing_Description_Short: A dark fantasy city builder where you must rebuild civilization in the face of apocalyptic rains. As the Queen’s Viceroy, lead humans, beavers, lizards, harpies, and foxes to reclaim the wilderness and secure a future for civilization's last survivors.
Marketing_DLC1Trailer1_Desc: Rebuild from the ruins with Frogs, the expert stonemasons and waterworkers, and send Striders on lucrative expeditions in the new Coastal Grove biome.

Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line01: Greetings, Viceroys, and welcome to the Ancient Seals Overview Briefing.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line02: Let us not waste time - the Blightstorm is almost upon us.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line03: It’s our last chance to close the Ancient Seal!
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line04: Ancient Seals are old, intricate structures built to hold a primeval, malevolent force at bay.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line05: As time passed, they became weaker, causing the mysterious Sealed Ones to slowly reclaim their dominion over our world.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line06: Your task as the Queen’s Viceroy is to settle the lands and journey into the heart of the Sealed Forest, where you must reforge the seal to imprison the evil gods.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line07: Our reports speak of 8 different seals.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line08: The farther away they are, the higher their difficulty,
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line09: and the more seal fragments will be required to repair the shattered seal.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line10: You can acquire seal fragments by establishing settlements,
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line12: and solving World Events encountered on your caravan's journey.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line13: At the start of every cycle, your caravan departs from the Smoldering City.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line14: You can upgrade your caravan permanently with Smoldering City upgrades that add new embarkation bonuses, increase its embarkation range, and much more.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line15: You can also modify the caravan temporarily with Royal Resupplies and World Events.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line16: Royal Resupplies are special rewards awarded for settling near negative modifiers.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line17: You can choose from three different one-time bonuses: increased vision and embarkation range, reserve embarkation points, or additional seal fragments. Choose your boon wisely.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line18: Reserve embarkation points are a separate pool of non-rechargeable embarkation points that can only be used during this cycle.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line19: You may want to save them for the most challenging endeavors.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line20: You can also improve your caravan by solving World Events.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line21: Yet, tread with caution. Your decisions often come with a trade-off, or present a unique challenge.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line22: Once you gather enough seal fragments, you can travel to the Sealed Forest - a grim, uninhabitable biome - where the Ancient Seals lie, and where your governing skills will be put to the test.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line23: This can only be attempted once per cycle.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line24: Ancient Seals spread corruption around them, making the Sealed Forest an extremely hostile environment.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line25: The flora in this region is bizarrely mutated.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line26: The overgrown trees contain extra resource charges.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line27: You will want your woodcutters to focus on them, for unlike anywhere else, the Hostility in the Sealed Forest grows with every felled tree.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line28: A broken Ancient Seal is concealed within the depths of the Sealed Forest. You must search for clues in the surrounding glades.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line29: Every glade contains a destroyed guidance stone that points to the location of the Ancient Seal.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line31: See, here’s the thing about the Sealed Forest. Viceroys don't embark there to establish settlements or gain Reputation. The Queen expects you to reforge the seal… Or die trying.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line32: To reforge the seal, you must construct the Ancient Guardian by obtaining its heart, blood, feathers, and life essence.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line33: There are three different variants of each part. Acquiring even one of them will require a display of remarkable finesse in a certain aspect of managing a settlement.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line34: Once you obtain the part, you will be rewarded with an Epic Cornerstone, and a new array of objectives will be revealed.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line35: After assembling all four parts, the Scorched Queen will breathe life into the Ancient Guardian - the only entity capable of closing the seal.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line36: But beware! The mere presence of the Ancient Seal summons foul plagues upon your settlement.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line37: Every storm season, a new plague will be unleashed, hindering your efforts to resurrect the Guardian.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line38: To oppose the tormenting force of the plagues, you can construct a Beacon Tower -
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line39: an ancient structure that allows you to summon aid directly from the Smoldering City, and choose up to five one-off abilities.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line40: This concludes our briefing. It’s time for you to put your knowledge into practice.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line41: Reforging each seal will not only grant you the Queen's appreciation and extra resources. It will also push back the Blightstorm and prolong the cycle permanently.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line42: It will be back. It always is. And yet, the horizon gleams with the promise of a brighter future.
Marketing_SealsTrailer_VO_Line43: I'm counting on you, Viceroys. May the Storm be gentle on you!
